# Agentic Architect · Sophia Stein
# https://llmstxt.org

> Practical AI workflows, non-coder automation courses, custom bottleneck sprints, and production AI advisory for business owners and modern organizations. Based in Boulder, Colorado.

Sophia Stein is an AI Systems Architect, Educator, and Advisor. Her background spans a B.S. in Computer Science from Columbia University, enterprise strategy and healthcare AI enablement at McKinsey & Company, and AI Systems & Enablement at Google (where she has led extensive internal AI trainings and co-invented a patent-pending AI system; all writing, teaching, and advising on this site are strictly in her personal capacity, views her own). She has trained 300+ founders and operators live at Boulder Startup Week and spoken for Women Who Code.

## Core Focus Areas

1. Non-Technical Business Owners & Operators: Portable Company Context Vaults (`voice.md` + `icp.md`), our free 5-day Prompt-to-System challenge, self-paced AI Workflow Academy ($297), guided 6-System Cohort, and focused custom automation sprints.
2. Cost Governance & Sovereign AI Infrastructure: Practical model routing, data privacy boundaries, and encrypted private AI setups you own.
3. Corporate Workshops, Keynotes & CTO Advisory: Hands-on enablement for organizations past the demo and stuck before production, plus CU Boulder course syllabi.

- /blog/ai-back-office : The 6-workflow AI Back Office to automate before hiring a $65,000 coordinator

- /blog/hire-ai-agency-vs-in-house : Cost & ownership comparison of $20k agencies vs courses, guided cohorts, custom sprints, and corporate workshops
